1.zh: 奉神旨意，照著在基督耶稣里生命的应许，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

1.zh: 写信给我亲爱的儿子提摩太。愿恩惠 、 怜悯 、 平安从父神和我们主基督耶稣归与你！
1.en: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1.zh: 我感谢神，就是我接续祖先用清洁的良心所事奉的神。祈祷的时候，不住的想念你！
1.en: I thank God, whom I serve, as my forefathers did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

1.zh: 记念你的眼泪，昼夜切切的想要见你，好叫我满心快乐。
1.en: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.

1.zh: 想到你心里无伪之信，这信是先在你外祖母罗以和你母亲友尼基心里的，我深信也在你的心里。
1.en: I have been reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.

1.zh: 为此我提醒你，使你将神藉我按手所给你的恩赐再如火挑旺起来。
1.en: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

1.zh: 因为神赐给我们，不是胆怯的心，乃是刚强 、 仁爱 、 谨守的心。
1.en: For God did not give us a spirit of timidity, but a spirit of power, of love and of self-discipline.

1.zh: 你不要以给我们的主作见证为耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的为耻；总要按神的能力，与我为福音同受苦难。
1.en: So do not be ashamed to testify about our Lord, or ashamed of me his prisoner. But join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God,

1.zh: 神救了我们，以圣召召我们，不是按我们的行为，乃是按他的旨意和恩典；这恩典是万古之先，在基督耶稣里赐给我们的，
1.en: who has saved us and called us to a holy life--not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

1.zh: 但如今藉著我们救主基督耶稣的显现才表明出来了。他已经把死废去，藉著福音，将不能坏的生命彰显出来。
1.en: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

1.zh: 我为这福音奉派作传道的，作使徒，作师傅。
1.en: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

1.zh: 为这缘故，我也受这些苦难。然而我不以为耻；因为知道我所信的是谁，也深信他能保全我所交付他的（或作：他所交托我的），直到那日。
1.en: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him for that day.

1.zh: 你从我听的那纯正话语的规模，要用在基督耶稣里的信心和爱心，常常守著。
1.en: What you heard from me, keep as the pattern of sound teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

1.zh: 从前所交托你的善道，你要靠著那住在我们里面的圣灵牢牢的守著。
1.en: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you--guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

1.zh: 凡在亚西亚的人都离弃我，这是你知道的，其中有腓吉路和黑摩其尼。
1.en: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

1.zh: 愿主怜悯阿尼色弗一家的人；因他屡次使我畅快，不以我的锁炼为耻，
1.en: May the Lord show mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains.

1.zh: 反倒在罗马的时候，殷勤的找我，并且找著了。
1.en: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.

1.zh: 愿主使他在那日得主的怜悯。他在以弗所怎样多多的服事我，是你明明知道的。
1.en: May the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! You know very well in how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.

2.zh: 我儿阿，你要在基督耶稣的恩典上刚强起来。
2.en: You then, my son, be strong in thegrace that is in Christ Jesus.

2.zh: 你在许多见证人面前听见我所教训的，也要交托那忠心能教导别人的人。
2.en: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable men who will also be qualified to teach others.

2.zh: 你要和我同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。
2.en: Endure hardship with us like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

2.zh: 凡在军中当兵的，不将世务缠身，好叫那招他当兵的人喜悦。
2.en: No one serving as a soldier gets involved in civilian affairs--he wants to please his commanding officer.

2.zh: 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。
2.en: Similarly, if anyone competes as an athlete, he does not receive the victor's crown unless he competes according to the rules.

2.zh: 劳力的农夫，理当先得粮食。
2.en: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.

2.zh: 我所说的话你要思想，因为凡事主必给你聪明。
2.en: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.

2.zh: 你要记念耶稣基督乃是大卫的后裔，他从死里复活，正合乎我所传的福音。
2.en: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

2.zh: 我为这福音受苦难，甚至被捆绑，像犯人一样。然而神的道却不被捆绑。
2.en: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.

2.zh: 所以我为选民凡事忍耐，叫他们也可以得著那在基督耶稣里的救恩和永远的荣耀。
2.en: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

2.zh: 有可信的话说：我们若与基督同死，也必与他同活；
2.en: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

2.zh: 我们若能忍耐，也必和他一同作王；我们若不认他，他也必不认我们；
2.en: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;

2.zh: 我们纵然失信，他仍是可信的，因为他不能背乎自己。
2.en: if we are faithless, he will remain faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

2.zh: 你要使众人回想这些事，在主面前嘱咐他们：不可为言语争辩；这是没有益处的，只能败坏听见的人。
2.en: Keep reminding them of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.

2.zh: 你当竭力在神面前得蒙喜悦，作无愧的工人，按著正意分解真理的道。
2.en: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a workman who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.

2.zh: 但要远避世俗的虚谈，因为这等人必进到更不敬虔的地步。
2.en: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.

2.zh: 他们的话如同毒疮，越烂越大；其中有许米乃和腓理徒，
2.en: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

2.zh: 他们偏离了真道，说复活的事已过，就败坏好些人的信心。
2.en: who have wandered away from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.

2.zh: 然而，神坚固的根基立住了；上面有这印记说：主认识谁是他的人；又说：凡称呼主名的人总要离开不义。
2.en: Nevertheless, God's solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."

2.zh: 在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器；有作为贵重的，有作为卑贱的。
2.en: In a large house there are articles not only of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for noble purposes and some for ignoble.

2.zh: 人若自洁，脱离卑贱的事，就必作贵重的器皿，成为圣洁，合乎主用，预备行各样的善事。
2.en: If a man cleanses himself from the latter, he will be an instrument for noble purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.

2.zh: 你要逃避少年的私欲，同那清心祷告主的人追求公义 、 信德 、 仁爱 、 和平。
2.en: Flee the evil desires of youth, and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, along with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

2.zh: 惟有那愚拙无学问的辩论，总要弃绝，因为知道这等事是起争竞的。
2.en: Don't have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.

2.zh: 然而主的仆人不可争竞，只要温温和和的待众人，善于教导，存心忍耐，
2.en: And the Lord's servant must not quarrel; instead, he must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.

2.zh: 用温柔劝戒那抵挡的人；或者神给他们悔改的心，可以明白真道，
2.en: Those who oppose him he must gently instruct, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,

2.zh: 叫他们这已经被魔鬼任意掳去的，可以醒悟，脱离他的网罗。
2.en: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

3.zh: 你该知道，末世必有危险的日子来到。
3.en: But mark this: There will be terribletimes in the last days.

3.zh: 因为那时人要专顾自己 、 贪爱钱财 、 自夸 、 狂傲 、 谤讟 、 违背父母 、 忘恩负义 、 心不圣洁 、
3.en: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

3.zh: 无亲情 、 不解怨 、 好说谗言 、 不能自约 、 性情凶暴 、 不爱良善 、
3.en: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,

3.zh: 卖主卖友 、 任意妄为 、 自高自大 、 爱宴乐 、 不爱神，
3.en: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God--

3.zh: 有敬虔的外貌，却背了敬虔的实意；这等人你要躲开。
3.en: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with them.

3.zh: 那偷进人家 、 牢笼无知妇女的，正是这等人。这些妇女担负罪恶，被各样的私欲引诱，
3.en: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over weak-willed women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,

3.zh: 常常学习，终久不能明白真道。
3.en: always learning but never able to acknowledge the truth.

3.zh: 从前雅尼和佯庇怎样敌挡摩西，这等人也怎样敌挡真道。他们的心地坏了，在真道上是可废弃的。
3.en: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth--men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.

3.zh: 然而他们不能再这样敌挡；因为他们的愚昧必在众人面前显露出来，像那二人一样。
3.en: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.

3.zh: 但你已经服从了我的教训 、 品行 、 志向 、 信心 、 宽容 、 爱心 、 忍耐，
3.en: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

3.zh: 以及我在安提阿 、 以哥念 、 路司得所遭遇的逼迫，苦难。我所忍受是何等的逼迫；但从这一切苦难中，主都把我救出来了。
3.en: persecutions, sufferings--what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

3.zh: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶稣里敬虔度日的也都要受逼迫。
3.en: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

3.zh: 只是作恶的和迷惑人的，必越久越恶，他欺哄人，也被人欺哄。
3.en: while evil men and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

3.zh: 但你所学习的，所确信的，要存在心里；因为你知道是跟谁学的，
3.en: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,

3.zh: 并且知道你是从小明白圣经，这圣经能使你因信基督耶稣，有得救的智慧。
3.en: and how from infancy you have known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 圣经都是神所默示的（或作：凡神所默示的圣经），于教训 、 督责 、 使人归正 、 教导人学义都是有益的，
3.en: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,

3.zh: 叫属神的人得以完全，预备行各样的善事。
3.en: so that the man of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

4.zh: 我在神面前，并在将来审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭著他的显现和他的国度嘱咐你：
4.en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:

4.zh: 务要传道，无论得时不得时，总要专心；并用百般的忍耐，各样的教训，责备人 、 警戒人 、 劝勉人。
4.en: Preach the Word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage--with great patience and careful instruction.

4.zh: 因为时候要到，人必厌烦纯正的道理，耳朵发痒，就随从自己的情欲，增添好些师傅，
4.en: For the time will come when men will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.

4.zh: 并且掩耳不听真道，偏向荒渺的言语。
4.en: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

4.zh: 你却要凡事谨慎，忍受苦难，做传道的工夫，尽你的职分。
4.en: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.

4.zh: 我现在被浇奠，我离世的时候到了。
4.en: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time has come for my departure.

4.zh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。
4.en: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

4.zh: 从此以后，有公义的冠冕为我存留，就是按著公义审判的主到了那日要赐给我的；不但赐给我，也赐给凡爱慕他显现的人。
4.en: Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day--and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.

4.zh: 你要赶紧的到我这里来。
4.en: Do your best to come to me quickly,

4.zh: 因为底马贪爱现今的世界，就离弃我往帖撒罗尼迦去了，革勒士往加拉太去，提多往挞马太去，
4.en: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

4.zh: 独有路加在我这里。你来的时候，要把马可带来，因为他在传道（或作：服事我）的事上于我有益处。
4.en: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.

4.zh: 我已经打发推基古往以弗所去。
4.en: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

4.zh: 我在特罗亚留于加布的那件外衣，你来的时候可以带来，那些书也要带来，更要紧的是那些皮卷。
4.en: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

4.zh: 铜匠亚力山大多多的害我；主必照他所行的报应他。
4.en: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.

4.zh: 你也要防备他，因为他极力敌挡了我们的话。
4.en: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

4.zh: 我初次申诉，没有人前来帮助，竟都离弃我；但愿这罪不归与他们。
4.en: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.

4.zh: 惟有主站在我旁边，加给我力量，使福音被我尽都传明，叫外邦人都听见；我也从狮子口里被救出来。
4.en: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion's mouth.

4.zh: 主必救我脱离诸般的凶恶，也必救我进他的天国。愿荣耀归给他，直到永永远远。阿们。
4.en: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

4.zh: 问百基拉 、 亚居拉，和阿尼色弗一家的人安。
4.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

4.zh: 以拉都在哥林多住下了。特罗非摩病了，我就留他在米利都。
4.en: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

4.zh: 你要赶紧在冬天以前到我这里来。有友布罗 、 布田 、 利奴 、 革老底亚，和众弟兄都问你安。
4.en: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers.

4.zh: 愿主与你的灵同在。愿恩惠常与你们同在！
4.en: The Lord be with your spirit.
